name: io.github.sapientsai/patents-mcp-server
description: Patent intelligence — USPTO Open Data, PTAB, EPO OPS and BigQuery full-text search.

environmentVariables.name: USPTO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: USPTO Open Data Portal key (data.uspto.gov) — enables ODP, PTAB, citations and office actions

environmentVariables.name: EPO_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EPO OPS consumer key (developers.epo.org) — enables international patent families and legal status

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to a GCP service-account key with bigquery.jobUser and bigquery.dataViewer — enables full-text search across 90M+ patents

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_JSON
environmentVariables.description: GCP service-account key as inline JSON — the alternative to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS when no file can be mounted

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: GCP project ID billed for the BigQuery queries

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to listen on when TRANSPORT is httpStream (default 8080)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: DEBUG, INFO (default), WARN or ERROR

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Interface to bind when TRANSPORT is httpStream (default 0.0.0.0)

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL used to build the /resources/{id}.pdf links that odp-download-document returns
